overview: Impact Capital Holdings Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场进行首次公开募股（IPO），发行 96,690,000 股新股。公司业务线涵盖 ICT 硬件与软件供应、ICT 设备与系统集成、ICT 及其他服务、可再生能源系统以及销售渠道。根据所提供公告，今年未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: Impact Capital Holdings Berhad conducted an initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in 2026, involving a public issue of 96,690,000 new ordinary shares. The company's business lines include ICT hardware and software supply, ICT equipment and systems integration, ICT and other services, renewable energy systems, and sales channels.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成首次公开募股并在 ACE 市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market in 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF IMPACT CAPITAL HOLDINGS BERHAD ("IMPACT CAPITAL" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE
actions.text: 进行首次公开募股，公开发行 96,690,000 股新股，并在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市。
actions.text_en: Conducted an initial public offering comprising a public issue of 96,690,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
